Dear @AndersBroman,

I have detected that since merge request 1494 was merged into the master, the script to generate automatically packet-goose.c by the ASN.1 to Wireshark dissector compiler is faling on my computer.

It reports "UnicodeDecodeError: 'charmap' codec can't decode byte 0x90 in position 152: character maps to <undefined>".

This is caused by the comment on the top of packet-goose-template.c: the name of the contributor includes some special characters probably from other encoding charset. 

To made the last commit I manually cut and pasted the problematic words when the script finished. But I do not know what is the right thing to do here (create an issue?). Just I let you know to evalute.

Thank you. Regards.

Hi,
I tried to fix up the commit but me and git are not friends so I managed to create a new MR. Once it's commited can you check it out and cancel this one please?
Best refards
Anders

Fixed files are now attached on a comment of the new MR.
Closing this MR.
